newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: AT&T-Unisource wins Russian internet contract.
newsitem.headline: AT&T-Unisource wins Russian internet contract.

text.p: AT&T-Unisource Communications Services said on Thursday it had won a contract to supply multi-megabit internet links to Russia's Sovam Teleport, one of the largest Russian data-network operators.

The links will give Sovam's international customers access to high quality, high speed internet connections to Europe and the United States, AT&T-Unisource said in a statement. No financial details were disclosed.
AT&T-Unisource is jointly owned by AT&T and Unisource, itself a joint venture between Dutch PTT, Telia of Sweden, Swiss Telecom PTT and Spain's Telefonica.
The company provides international voice, data and messaging services for companies operating in Europe, it said.
AT&T-Unisource has high-speed points of presence in 13 European countries, with coverage set to double to 26 by the middle of next year, it said.

Sovam Teleport provides data transmission services to thousands of customers in the Commonwealth of Independent States, AT&T-Unisource said. It launched the first mainstream Russian internet service, Russia-On-Line in 1995.
